punchline: Same street, different pipe: Snow found his clean comparison.
thirty_sec: William Farr's statistics linked cholera deaths to low ground. John Snow found London houses on the same streets served by two water companies, tested the water with silver nitrate and compared deaths: 315 per 10,000 houses against 37.
question: Which two groups in your work differ in only one respect?
key_contrast: A pattern showed where cholera struck; one clean comparison showed why.
